cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You called my audition interesting. What came after that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to be encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then give me the encouraging half and the half you swallowed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better by how much? Are we buying dance lessons or shoes that don't move?

mechanism: A corrects incomplete answers as inadequate professional feedback to extract the truth B is cushioning.
confusable: General suspicion differs from probing specific omissions in each careful answer with expert standards.
comparison: Sibling audition feedback protects feelings; meeting minutes protect the proposal and conceal its replacement presenter.
seedUse: Keep the exact careful phrases as hooks for the next question rather than treating B as a generic evasive witness.
